### Bio:

My research interests lie at the intersection of causal AI, real-world evidence, and personalized interventions — particularly as they apply to rare diseases and clinical decision support. I am especially drawn to methodologies that can translate complex patient data into actionable, equitable health insights.

Beyond research, I enjoy fitness, nutrition, and staying active.

Always happy to connect, collaborate, and talk about research, life, love, and everything in between!
